title: Reactions of nitroxides, part 7: Synthesis of novel nitroxide selenoureas
abstract: AbstractThe reactions of 4‐isoselenocyanato‐2,2,6,6‐tetramethylpiperidine‐1‐oxyl with selected amines and lower alcohols give the corresponding novel selenoureas and selenocarbamates, all bearing the nitroxyl moiety. Some of the synthesized selenoureas and selenocarbamates show moderate‐to‐good activity against pathogenic fungi. © 2008 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Heteroatom Chem 19:549–556, 2008; Published online in Wiley InterScience (www.interscience.wiley.com). DOI 10.1002/hc.20454
